title: JSON Parser 100% From Scratch in Haskell (only 111 lines)
summary: Tsoding live-codes a JSON parser from scratch in Haskell in about 111 lines, using only the standard library. It is an edited Twitch stream that explains the intuition behind parser combinators, functors, applicatives and monads.
why: HN recommends it as a hands-on way to understand Haskell and parser combinators by watching a parser get built live.

quote.text: this guy writes a json parser live, giving his intuition along the way. It's helped me immensely.
